mapper.sql: id, symbol, name, name_ko, exchange, asset_class, sector, cik, fractionable, is_active, inactive_reason, synced_at
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, name, name_ko AS nameKo, exchange, asset_class AS assetClass, is_active AS active FROM stocks WHERE symbol LIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') OR name_ko LIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN symbol = #{q} THEN 0 WHEN symbol LIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, is_active DESC, symbol LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT symbol, name, name_ko AS nameKo, exchange, asset_class AS assetClass, is_active AS active FROM stocks
ORDER BY symbol LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stocks (symbol, name, exchange, asset_class, fractionable, is_active, synced_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{name}, #{exchange}, #{assetClass}, #{fractionable}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), exchange = VALUES(exchange), asset_class = VALUES(asset_class), fractionable = VALUES(fractionable), is_active = 1, inactive_reason = NULL, synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE stocks SET is_active = 0, inactive_reason = '벤더 목록에서 제외됨' WHERE synced_at < #{threshold} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE stocks SET name_ko = #{nameKo}, name_ko_synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND (name_ko IS NULL OR name_ko <> #{nameKo})

UPDATE stocks SET security_type = #{securityType}, isin = #{isin}, asset_class = #{assetClass}, type_synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND (security_type IS NULL OR security_type <> #{securityType} OR asset_class <> #{assetClass})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocks WHERE security_type IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stocks WHERE name_ko IS NOT NULL
SELECT symbol FROM stocks WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY symbol
